## What it is

`screen_wedge` stood at desk tilt with a rough Waveshare module obstacle. `screen_base` is out of scope for now.

## Design notes

- Wedge print pose is frame-on-bed (+Z toward the rear). Stand is translate, Y180, then `Rot(tilt)`.
- Module block is an obstacle for scale, not a fit check.

## Don't

- Don't treat the module obstacle as a mating solid — it is approximate.
- Don't pull `screen_base` back into this assembly until the desk mount is in scope again.
- Don't stand the wedge without the Y180 — the glass sits on the bed facing -Z in the part file.
